_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro: Siz {player_id} o'yinchisiz, {num_rounds} turdagi takrorlanadigan ultimatum o'yinini o'ynashda. Sizda bu turni o'zingiz va {other_id} o'yinchi o'rtasida bo'lish uchun $ {pool} bor. Taklifchi: - Taklif qiling: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool) - Agar qabul qilinsa → Siz $ │ pool - X olasiz, boshqa o'yinchi $ X olasiz - Agar rad etilsa → Ikkalasi ham $ 0 olasiz - Misol: [Offer: $3] yoki "Men buni adolatli deb o'ylayman. [Offer: $5] " Javob beruvchi: - Taklifni [Accept] yoki [Reject] bilan hal qiling - Misol: "Bu oqilona ko'rinadi. [Accept] " " Juda adolatsiz. [Reject] "

round.begins: --- Raund {round_number} boshlanadi! --- O'yinchi {proposer_id} taklif qiluvchi, O'yinchi {responder_id} javob beruvchi.
round.offer: Raund {round_number}: O'yinchi {proposer_id} o'yinchi {responder_id}ga ${offer} taklif qiladi (${keep} ni o'zida qoldiradi).
round.accepted: O'yinchi {responder_id} qabul qilindi! Raund {round_number} yutuqlari: O'yinchi {proposer_id} + ${proposer_gain}, O'yinchi {responder_id} + ${responder_gain}. Yangi umumiy: O'yinchi 0: ${total_0}, O'yinchi 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: O'yinchi {responder_id} taklifni rad etdi! Raund {round_number} yutuqlari: Ikkala o'yinchi ham +$0. Jami qolmoqda: O'yinchi 0: ${total_0}, O'yinchi 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Taklif beruvchi [Offer: $X] shaklida taklif berishi kerak.
invalid_move.bad_integer: Taklif summasi haqiqiy butun son bo'lishi kerak.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Javob berish uchun hozircha taklif yo'q.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Taklifni qabul qiluvchi taklifni [Accept] yoki [Reject] shaklida taqdim etishi kerak.

outcome.win: O'yinchi {winner} ${winner_total} bilan o'yinchi {loser}ning ${loser_total}ga qarshi g'alaba qozondi.
outcome.draw: Durang! Ikki o'yinchi ham ${total} jami bilan tugadi.
